reconstructed_captions.10: After reaching the top of the bank, he walks further into the woods.
reconstructed_captions.11: He finds a suitable spot and begins clearing leaves from the ground.
reconstructed_captions.12: He gathers several stones and arranges them in a circle to create a fire pit.
reconstructed_captions.13: He continues to build the rock ring for the fire pit.
reconstructed_captions.14: He gathers a handful of dry twigs and leaves to use as kindling.
reconstructed_captions.15: He kneels down and carefully places the kindling inside the fire pit.
reconstructed_captions.16: He takes out a fire-starting tool from his pocket.
reconstructed_captions.17: He strikes the tool against a metal scraper, creating a shower of sparks.
reconstructed_captions.18: He aims the sparks into the pile of kindling and tinder.
reconstructed_captions.19: After a few tries, a small ember begins to glow in the tinder.
reconstructed_captions.20: He carefully places more fine tinder around the glowing ember.
reconstructed_captions.21: He leans in close to the fire pit to protect the ember from the wind.
reconstructed_captions.22: He begins to blow gently on the ember to encourage it to grow.
reconstructed_captions.23: The ember glows brighter as he continues to blow on it softly.
reconstructed_captions.24: He leans in closer, preparing to blow more steadily to start a flame.
